title: Astrid and the Glasshouse
author: Noor Ashgrove
blurb: Coral Vane, a letter-writer sending postcards to an address that burned down years ago, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must return to the place where the story went wrong before the house sale closes.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
